evidence_tier: REAL. WP2 Phase 0 confirmatory synthesis: the affine law, per-cell kappa_pred, and m(alpha) were discovered through inverted predictions and exploratory analysis (Blocks A-C); this battery is their first test on fresh seeds (seed 20260820) and on an alpha the law has never seen (0.02). Four environments (claims, claims-logit, spike, tickets: one blind-driver-with-defense, one continuous-score, one adversarial-kappa, one high-damage world), alpha grid {0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15}, temper family plus two realistic axes (deprivation, starvation) per environment, 300 trials per cell, paired-difference form throughout.
law_under_test: paired_diff = m(alpha) * kappa_pred * a per cell, with b(env) the oracle plateau margin as the affine intercept of the raw-excess form (F17/F18). m fitted through the origin on guarded temper cells per env-alpha; residuals tested on ALL cells including the realistic axes the fit never saw.

predictions.P0-1: b anchors transfer to fresh seeds: mean oracle margin over the alpha = 0.10 temper cells lands within +/- 0.004 of the archived values: claims -0.0042, claims_logit -0.0015, spike -0.0132, tickets -0.0063.
predictions.P0-2: Oracle safety: the oracle arm's mean risk never exceeds alpha by more than 2 SE in any of the 384 cells, at every alpha including 0.02.
predictions.P0-3: RISKY (extreme-alpha structure): in the two wide-kappa environments (spike, tickets), at EVERY alpha including 0.02, the through-origin regression of measured kappa on kappa_pred over guarded temper cells has R2 >= 0.5 with n_guarded >= 5. Wrong-mass near threshold is scarce at 0.02 and the law has never seen it; if the FD instrument or the law fails there, that boundary is the finding.
predictions.P0-4: m windows from B1/B3/C, widened honestly for fresh seeds and temper-only fits: m(0.10) in [1.00, 1.35] in each of the four environments; m(0.05) on claims in [1.35, 1.90].
predictions.P0-5: Alpha-dependence replicates out of family: m(0.05) > m(0.10) in every environment where both are measurable, and within each environment m is weakly increasing as alpha falls across all measurable alphas (measurable = n_guarded >= 4 and degenerate cells excluded by the registered pin rule).
predictions.P0-6: Family invariance at fixed alpha: max pairwise |m_i(0.10) - m_j(0.10)| across the four environments <= 0.25 (the TOST margin re-used).
predictions.P0-7: The collapse survives fresh data at every alpha: per env-alpha, >= 90% of all cells (temper AND realistic) sit within max(3*SE_pd, 0.0075) of m * kappa_pred * a, and Spearman(pd, a) >= 0.9 over cells with |a| >= 2*SE_a (noise-floor exclusion registered per the F13 lesson).

falsifiers.P0-1: A miss beyond 0.004 in any environment means the intercept is not a stable environment constant and Phase 3's b_bound term must be measured per deployment rather than per environment.
falsifiers.P0-2: Standing bug-presumption path; an oracle violation at 0.02 specifically would implicate the B/(n+1) handling at extreme alpha.
falsifiers.P0-3: R2 < 0.5 or guard starvation at alpha 0.02 in either wide-kappa world means the law's computable part does not extend to extreme alpha; Phase 1 then requires an alpha-extreme mechanism cell and the certificate's stated alpha domain shrinks accordingly.
falsifiers.P0-4/5: m outside the windows or non-monotone in alpha kills the 'single amplification factor m(alpha)' reading; H4 (m as local secant of a curved relation) gains weight and Phase 1's H4 discriminator becomes primary.
falsifiers.P0-6: Family variance beyond 0.25 at fixed alpha means m is not a clean function of (alpha, n_cal) and H3 (per-covariate threshold averaging) gains weight.
falsifiers.P0-7: Residual failures concentrated on the realistic axes (which the temper fit never saw) would mean the temper family does not span realistic estimator error at the new alphas, and the battery's transfer claim fails exactly there.

decision_rule: m per env-alpha: through-origin regression of (paired_diff / a) on kappa_pred over temper cells passing the registered guards (|a| >= 0.003, slope_what >= 0.02, kappa_pred computable as ratio of trial-mean FD slopes at h = 0.05, pin fraction <= 0.5 at both grid ends). Cells with pin fraction > 0.5 are labelled degenerate and excluded from m fits per the B1 lesson (alpha matters only while it binds); they still appear in the cell table. Residual and rank tests as stated in P0-7. Verdicts prediction-by-prediction, misses verbatim.
notes: Design-phase audit, disclosed and never citable: 30-trial probes (scratchpad phase0_audit.py) found no threshold pinning anywhere except claims_logit at alpha 0.15 (pin_lo 0.20 of trials), kappa_pred ranges wide on spike (0.79-2.55) and tickets (0.77-2.23) and narrow on claims/claims_logit (about 1.0-1.26), which is why P0-3's R2 clause names only spike and tickets. The probe's per-trial ratio-of-ratios m estimates were unstable; the battery uses the archived ratio-of-trial-means machinery. Archived anchors: m(0.10) = 1.159 +/- 0.020 claims, 1.070 +/- 0.017 tickets (recomputed from archived batteries joined to Block A kappa_pred), 1.243 +/- 0.054 spike (PC-2), about 1.18 claims_logit (B3); m(0.05) = 1.61-1.77 claims (B1). Windows widened beyond these because fresh seeds, temper-only fits, and battery-internal kappa_pred all move the point estimate.

verdicts.run: artifacts/wp2p0_ec15383b39b52206, EVIDENCE TIER, 384 cells, 300 trials/cell, fresh seed 20260820
verdicts.P0-1: CONFIRMED 4/4: fresh b anchors land within 0.0004 of archived (claims -0.0040 vs -0.0042; claims_logit -0.0015 vs -0.0015; spike -0.0136 vs -0.0132; tickets -0.0063 vs -0.0063). The intercept is a stable environment constant.
verdicts.P0-2: CONFIRMED: zero of 384 cells have oracle mean - alpha - 2SE > 0; worst cell sits at -0.0007. Oracle safety holds at every alpha including 0.02.
verdicts.P0-3: SPLIT, filed verbatim. Tickets holds at EVERY alpha including the never-seen 0.02 (R2 0.517 at n_guarded 5, rising to 0.869 at 0.15). Spike holds at 0.05/0.10/0.15 (R2 0.598 to 0.863) but GUARD-STARVES at 0.02 (3 guarded cells): with |a| proportional to alpha, the absolute |a| >= 0.003 guard removes the small-gamma cells exactly where the law would be tested. The registered falsifier reading stands: at alpha 0.02 and n_cal 1000 the law is only measurable in worlds whose aligned errors are large, and the certificate's alpha domain statement must carry this boundary. A relative (alpha-scaled) guard is the registered instrument follow-up, to be applied only in a NEW registration, never retrofitted.
verdicts.P0-4: CONFIRMED 5/5: m(0.10) = 1.128 claims, 1.071 claims_logit, 1.229 spike, 1.073 tickets, all inside [1.00, 1.35]; m(0.05) claims = 1.449 inside [1.35, 1.90].
verdicts.P0-5: SPLIT 2/4, misses verbatim, and the misses restructure the law. Claims (0.956 to 1.128 to 1.449) and claims_logit (0.362 degenerate-dominated, 1.071, 1.152) are monotone as alpha falls. Spike misses by a hair (1.221 at 0.05 vs 1.229 at 0.10, within one combined SE, letter of the clause violated). Tickets misses STRUCTURALLY: m rises to 1.838 +/- 0.102 at 0.05 then FALLS to 1.261 +/- 0.180 at 0.02. m(alpha) is not a universal monotone function of alpha; its alpha-shape is environment-dependent, largest where the local loss geometry near the crossing is coarsest. Registered follow-up assigned to the Phase 1 confirmation experiment.
verdicts.P0-6: CONFIRMED at 0.10 (spread 0.158 <= 0.25: 1.071 to 1.229). NOTED BEYOND THE REGISTRATION: at alpha 0.05 the spread is 0.69 (claims_logit 1.152 to tickets 1.838), so family invariance is an alpha-0.10 phenomenon, not a law; this feeds the same Phase 1 follow-up as P0-5.
verdicts.P0-7: SPLIT 9/16 env-alphas fully pass, misses verbatim with a two-part diagnosis the cell table supports. (i) All 0.02 blocks except tickets fail the >= 90% clause because zero-to-few cells pass the kappa_pred guards (0/0 residuals testable on claims and claims_logit at 0.02); where cells are testable at 0.02 (tickets) the collapse holds 24/24 at rank rho 0.914. (ii) Every other failing residual sits at the LARGEST |a| cells (gamma = 0 endpoints and the deprivation cells that reproduce them) with NEGATIVE residuals: the second-order compression regime, arriving at |a| about 0.015 on spike (nearer than F7's 0.04 placeholder boundary) and amplified at alpha 0.15 by threshold pinning (pin fractions up to 1.00, inventoried in the artifact). The misses are NOT concentrated on realistic axes per se: deprivation cells land where their aligned error says, exactly as F14 found; they fail only where their matched temper endpoint also fails.
verdicts.note: The claims_logit alpha 0.15 m = 0.362 +/- 0.269 is reported but sits on 4 guarded cells in a block where 18 of 24 cells are majority-pinned (registered degeneracy rule); it is a measurement of degeneracy, not of the law.
